verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Grok Bot runs on a cloud computer with a browser and can use browser-based tools. Nothing documents web-grounded answers or citations linking back to sources. Browsing is an adjacent capability, not the story's research-answers-with-citations feature, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can get answers grounded in current web results with citations back to the sources
